Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The players are out in the middle. Scott Edwards and Musa Ahmed will open the batting for Netherlands. Yamin Ahmadzai will begin the proceedings with the ball. Here we go...
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Right then! Netherlands have a target of 238 to chase and have an opportunity to level the series here. However, the wicket is looking tough to bat on, and Afghanistan would be thinking that they certainly have a slight edge over their opponents. An exciting chase coming up, stay tuned!

Rahmanullah Gurbaz, the man of the moment, is up for a quick chat. He says that this was a special innings for him. Tells that he wanted to play a big innings for his team and wanted to stay on the wicket for long. Mentions that the wicket is not easy to bat on and they have posted a good total on the board.

A fine bowling performance from the Dutch, they were right on cue. Although, they failed to grab wickets, they bowled tight lines and lengths and did not give away any freebies to the batters. Philippe Boissevain was the leader of the pack, he scalped two vital wickets and was very economical too. Fred Klaassen too, did well in his spell of 10 overs and grabbed two wickets. Netherlands' bowlers have done a fine job once again, and will be hoping that the batters get them over the line this time around.

Afghanistan lost an early wicket, but Rahmanullah Gurbaz and Rahmat Shah did well to rebuild the innings and put 83 runs together. Hashmatullah Shahidi brought up yet another fifty, but he perished soon after. Gurbaz scored a sublime century but he too, could not hold on till the very end. Afghanistan were only dealing singles and doubles, they were unable to find the boundary ropes, courtesy of some fine bowling by the Dutch. Afghanistan have put a handy total of 237. Not to forget, Afghanistan defended a lower total in the first ODI, and they have a world-class spin bowling attack and could very well repeat the same here.

Netherlands would be the happier side at the end of the innings. Although, they did not pick up wickets at regular intervals, they were very disciplined with their bowling and have restricted Afghanistan under the 240-run mark. They have an opportunity here to level the series, but it's not going to be an easy task against a world-class spin attack of Afghanistan.

OUT! CAUGHT! A wicket to end the innings and Netherlands have done well to pull things back at the fag end. This was a full ball, outside off. Rashid Khan slices it uppishly and he fails to get the desired distance. He hits it straight to Bas de Leede at deep extra cover who takes a simple catch. Afghanistan finish with 237/6.
Commentary.Howout: c Bas de Leede b Fred Klaassen

Commentary.Commentary: A short ball, around off. Najibullah Zadran pulls it towards deep square leg for a run.
SIX! Much-needed maximum for Afghanistan! Fuller in length, outside off. Najibullah Zadran reaches out and smacks it way over the deep extra cover fence for a biggie.
Short of a length, outside off. Rashid Khan drags it wide of the long on fielder and settles for just the single.
Back of a length, outside off. Rashid Khan looks to cut but he misses.

DROPPED! A tough one though! Full ball, around off. Najibullah Zadran heaves it high in the air towards the deep mid-wicket region. The fielder there settles under it and puts it down. The batters cross for a single.
A slower ball, fuller in lenhgth, angling in late from middle. Rashid Khan looks to heave it to the leg side but he misses and gets hit low on his pad.
In the air...but safe! Fuller in length, outside off. Najibullah Zadran slices it uppishly towards the deep extra cover region. It falls short of the fielder and the batters collect a run.
On a length, around off. Rashid Khan drags it towards deep mid-wicket for a single. This is good death bowling from Netherlands!
On a length, angling in from middle. Najibullah Zadran whips it towards the deep square leg region. Fielder is stationed there and the ball goes straight to him. A single taken.
A yorker-length ball, outside off. Rashid Khan drills it towards long on and settles for a run.
Length ball, around leg. Najibullah Zadran heaves it towards deep square leg for a run.
A slower ball, into the wicket, outside off. Rashid Khan skips down to slog but ut goes off the shoudler of the bat towards cover.

A yorker-length ball, around off. Rashid Khan looks to slog but it goes off the toe end to the left of the bowler. Fred Klaassen reaches towards the bowler but is a bit lazy to throw it to his end. Rashid Khan comes back for the second run.

FOUR! WOW! Where did that come from? Good-length ball, angling in from middle. Rashid Khan stays back, gets low and whips it behind square on the leg side for a boundary. Afghanistan have got a boundary after 94 deliveries!
Swing and a miss! Length ball, well outside off. Rashid Khan looks to slog but he misses as the ball goes past his blade.
Back of a length, around leg. Najibullah Zadran nudges it to the leg side and can manage only a run.
Full ball, on off. Rashid Khan goes for a massive heave but it goes off the toe end towards the off side. A single taken.
Fred Klaassen comes back on!
Leg bye! Full ball, angling in from middle. Rashid Khan misses his flick and gets hit low on his pad. The ball rolls to the leg side for a leg bye.
Brilliant bowling! A pin-point yorker, around off. Rashid Khan squeezes it out to the off side.
Wide! Kingma errs in line and serves it way down leg. Rashid Khan misses his flick and the umpire calls it as a wide.
A yorker-length ball, around middle. Rashid Khan digs it out to the leg side and comes back for the second run.
Good-length ball, around middle and leg. Najibullah Zadran turns it to the leg side for a single.
On a length, well outside off. Rashid Khan cuts it to sweeper cover and settles for a run.
Good-length ball, around middle. Najibullah Zadran nudges it towards deep square leg for a single.
Flatter ball, on a length, outside off. Rashid Khan pushes it to the fielder at cover.
On a length, darted on the pads. Najibullah Zadran flicks it towards deep square leg for a single.
Flatter ball, around leg. Najibullah Zadran keeps it out.
Flatter ball, outside off. Rashid Khan cuts it to deep cover for a run.
Rashid Khan walks out to bat at number 7.

OUT! STUMPED! Afghanistan lose another and Netherlands are staging a great comeback here! Flatter ball, well outside off. Gulbadin Naib skips down the track and looks to slog but he misses and Scott Edwards behind the sticks collects the ball cleanly. He whips the bails off and Gulbadin Naib is well short of his crease.
Commentary.Howout: st Scott Edwards b Colin Ackermann

Commentary.Commentary: Flatter ball, around leg. Gulbadin Naib looks to leave it alone but the ball brushes off his thigh pad towards the keeper.
Slower ball, around the pads once again. Gulbadin Naib flicks it toward deep square leg for a single. He will keep strike for the next over.
Good-length delivery, on the pads. Najibullah Zadran works it away towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Another slower ball, on a length. Najibullah Zadran taps it towards cover.
Slower ball, around middle. Gulbadin Naib knocks it down to mid on for a single. He is off the mark straightaway!
Gulbadin Naib is the new man in.

OUT! CLEANED HIM UP! Ryan Klein keeps it simple and attacks the stumps! He gets his first international wicket! A fuller ball, outside off. Hashmatullah Shahidi tries to play across the line and looks to go over mid-wicket but misses and the ball goes on to knock over the off pole. A well-made fifty by the skipper, but he has to walk back now. Good passage of play here for Netherlands!
Touch shorter, outside off. Hashmatullah Shahidi misses his pull.
BEATEN! A beauty by Colin Ackermann! Fuller, spinning away from the batter. Najibullah Zadran hangs back and looks to block this but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Fuller, on middle. Blocked out.
A fuller ball, outside off. Hashmatullah Shahidi lofts it over cover for a single.
A fuller ball, on middle. Hashmatullah Shahidi looks to heave this but gets an inside egde onto the pads.
Another fuller ball, outside off. Najibullah Zadran knocks it down to long off for another single.
Loopy ball, fuller, around off. Hashmatullah Shahidi leans and drives it towards long off for a single.
Fuller ball, on middle. Hashmatullah Shahidi drives it towards long on for a single.
LEG BYE! On the pads, on a length. Najibullah Zadran misses his flick and the ball deflects off his pads and rolls towards fine leg for a leg bye.
Good running! Back of a length, around middle. Najibullah Zadran punches it down to long on for a couple of runs.
Takes the pace off once again. on a fuller length, around middle. Hashmatullah Shahidi knocks it down to long on for a single.
Another slower ball, full in length, around middle. Hashmatullah Shahidi drags it down towards the man at mid on
Slower ball, around off. Hashmatullah Shahidi pushes it back to the bowler.
Fred Klaassen (7-1-30-1) is back on.
Shorter ball, on middle. Hashmatullah Shahidi pulls it towards deep square leg for a single. FIFTY FOR Hashmatullah Shahidi! Back-to-back fifties for the skipper, he has been in some fine touch.
Nicely played! A fuller ball, outside off. Hashmatullah Shahidi stays in his crease, opens the face of his bat and guides it towards third man for a single.
Wide of off, on a shorter length. Najibullah Zadran cuts it past the fielder at point for a single.
Shorter ball, outside off. Hashmatullah Shahidi hangs back and pushes it towards the man at cover. A single taken.
Outside off, Hashmatullah Shahidi cuts it towards the fielder at point.
Najibullah Zadran walks out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT! Rahmanullah Gurbaz falls soon after his century! Afghanistan needed boundaries and Rahmanullah Gurbaz had to go for it. A loopy ball, fuller in length, around middle. Rahmanullah Gurbaz steps down the pitch and looks to heave this over long off, but miscues it and fails to get the distance. Ryan Klein at long off, takes a good low catch to dismiss Rahmanullah Gurbaz. Deserving wicket for Philippe Boissevain and that ends an impressive innings from Gurbaz!
Commentary.Howout: c Ryan Klein b Philippe Boissevain

Commentary.Commentary: Another slower ball, fuller in length, around the off pole. Rahmanullah Gurbaz pushes it towards long on for a single. Singles will surely not hurt Netherlands.
Slower ball, around the off pole, full in length. Hashmatullah Shahidi clips it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Very full, takes the pace off again, around the leg stump. Rahmanullah Gurbaz backs away and whips it towards deep square leg. A single taken.
Shorter, slower, on middle. Hashmatullah Shahidi pulls it gently towards deep square leg and rotates the strike.
Another length ball, outside off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz shuffles across and dabs it towards third man for another single.
A slower ball, outside off, on a length. Hashmatullah Shahidi pushes it towards cover and takes a single.
Time for Powerplay 3! Netherlands can now have a maximum of 5 fielders outside the ring till the end of the innings.

Excellent running and Rahmanullah Gurbaz gets to his hundred! What an innings this has been from the young man! This is tossed up, well outside off. Gurbaz lunges forward and carves it through the cover-point region for a couple of runs. He removes his helmet and punches the air in delight! He receives a standing ovation from his teammates in the dug out! Top innings from a very talented youngster! He must now ensure that his side finishes the innings on a high!
Floated, on a length, outside off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz drives it but finds the fielder at cover.
Flatter ball, on a length, turning in from middle. Hashmatullah Shahidi tucks it towards deep square leg for a run.
A tight single! Philippe Boissevain fires in a quicker ball, around middle. Gurbaz stays back and pushes it to the off side. He scampers through to the other end.
Another flighted delivery, on a length, around off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz lunges forward and pushes it to the man at cover.
Well bowled! Nicely tossed up, around off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz prods and blocks it out.
Back of a length, around off. Hashmatullah Shahidi stays back and taps it to the fielder at backward point.
On a length, angling in from middle. Gurbaz tucks it to the leg side but settles for a single this time.
Good-length ball, around middle. Rahmanullah Gurbaz nudges it wide of the deep square leg fielder and comes back for the second run. He moves onto 96 now!
A slower ball, on a length, outside off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz looks to cut but it goes off the underedge and onto the deck.
Wide! Klein errs in line and spills this one down leg. Rahmanullah Gurbaz lets it be and the umpire calls it as a wide.
Good-length ball, on off. Hashmatullah Shahidi taps it to the off side and scampers through to the other end. Still no boundaries for Afghanistan.
Play and a miss! Full ball, outside off and angling across the batter. Hashmatullah Shahidi looks for a booming drive but he misses.
Flatter ball, on a length, outside off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz cuts it wide of the deep cover fielder for a couple of runs. He is just one hit away from a hundred now!
Flatter ball, darted on the pads. Hashmatullah Shahidi nudges it to the leg side for a run.
Hashmatullah Shahidi tries to be innovative but he fails to get any bat on it. Tossed up, around leg. Hashmatullah Shahidi looks to play the switch hit but he misses and gets hit on his pad.
Flatter ball, around off. Hashmatullah Shahidi taps it towards backward point.
Fuller in length, outside off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz drills it to deep cover for a run.

BEATEN! Turn and bounce for Philippe Boissevain! He tosses it up, well outside off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz sees the flight and looks to go over cover but he misses as the ball spins past his outside edge.
Philippe Boissevain (5-0-26-1) comes back to the bowl.
On a length, around off. Hashmatullah Shahidi defends it towards cover.
Good-length ball, around middle. Rahmanullah Gurbaz nudges it to the leg side and takes a single.
Tap and run! Good-length ball, around off. Hashmatullah Shahidi defends it to the off side and scampers through to the other end.
On a length, around off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz taps it to the off side and takes off for a single.
Hammered but for no run! Length ball, around off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz skips down the track and drills it to the fielder at mid off. The fielder there dives to his left and stops the ball.
Length ball, around off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz blocks it off the front foot.
Ryan Klein (4-0-31-0) is brought back into the attack.
Another delivery, shorter in length, outside off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz cuts it hard but straight to the fielder at deep cover. A single to end the over.
Slightly shorter in length, outside off. Hashmatullah Shahidi stays back and punches it through the cover region for a run.
Flatter and quicker, outside off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz eases it down to long on for a run.
On a length, darted on the pads. Hashmatullah Shahidi tucks it to the leg side for a run.
Flatter and quicker, outside off and turning in late. Hashmatullah Shahidi gets cramped for room and he keeps it out in the end.
A slower ball, outside off, on a length. Rahmanullah Gurbaz hangs back and pushes it towards cover for a single.

DRINKS! Afghanistan are in a very comfortable position right now and their top order has laid a very good foundation for the other batters to take advantage of it. Netherlands will look to chip in with wickets and ensure that Afghanistan don't run away with score in the first innings. Rahmanullah Gurbaz is nearing a hundred and it will be interesting to see his approach going ahead in the innings.
On a length. darting it on the pads. Hashmatullah Shahidi flicks it to mid-wicket.
Fuller ball, slower on this occasion, outside off. Hashmatullah Shahidi leans and taps it to extra cover.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Hashmatullah Shahidi defends it out to the fielder at cover.
Good-length delivery, on the pads this time. Rahmanullah Gurbaz works it away towards fine leg. A single taken.
Takes the pace off again, on a fuller length, outside off. Hashmatullah Shahidi leans and taps it towards cover and scampers through to the other end.
A slower ball, outside off, on a length. Rahmanullah Gurbaz taps it towards cover for a single.
Flatter ball, around middle and off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz knocks it towards long on for a single. He will keep the strike for the next over.
Much quicker, around middle and off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz makes room and cuts it towards the fielder at cover.
Shorter ball, around middle. Hashmatullah Shahidi stays in his crease and pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Loopy ball, full in length. Hashmatullah Shahidi looks to sweep this away but misses.
Fuller, around middle. Rahmanullah Gurbaz, on the back foot, pushes it towards long on for a single.
Flatter delivery, outside off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz hangs back and pushes it back to the bowler.
On a length, just outside off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz pushes it towards cover and takes an easy single.
Good running! Length ball, around leg. Rahmanullah Gurbaz clips it behind square on the leg side for a couple of runs.
Good-length ball, around off. Hashmatullah Shahidi taps it to the off side for a quick run.

A loud shout for caught behind but the umpire says no! Good-length ball, jagging back in a bit from outside off. Hashmatullah Shahidi looks to cut but gets cramped for room. The ball goes off his thigh pad towards the keeper.
Another slower ball, into the deck, outside off. Hashmatullah Shahidi skips down to slog but it goes off the inside edge towards the keeper.
A slower ball, fuller in length, outside off. Hashmatullah Shahidi pushes it towards cover.
Shorter this time, around middle. Hashmatullah Shahidi pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single. He retains the strike.
FOUR! A low full toss, slower through the air. Hashmatullah Shahidi gets low and sweeps this towards deep square leg for a boundary.
Flatter, darting it onto the pads. Hashmatullah Shahidi misses his glance and gets an outside edge towards the off side.
Loopy ball, around middle. Hashmatullah Shahidi leans and defends it out.
Angling it on the pads, touch quicker. Hashmatullah Shahidi blocks it out towards mid-wicket.
Fuller ball, around off. Hashmatullah Shahidi dabs it towards point.

LEG BYE! A stifled appeal for LBW but turned down. A slower ball, on the pads. Hashmatullah Shahidi misses his flick and gets rapped on the pads. The ball rolls towards the leg side and the batters steal a leg bye.
Another slower ball, around middle. Hashmatullah Shahidi blocks it out.
Slower ball, on a length, around middle. Rahmanullah Gurbaz pushes it towards square leg for a single.
Back of a length delivery, around middle. Rahmanullah Gurbaz taps it towards mid-wicket.
Length ball, around leg. Hashmatullah Shahidi tucks it towards square leg for a single.

Slower ball, outside off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz taps it to point. He wanted a single there, but he was denied by his partner. The fielder has a shy at the keeper's end but misses. The batters pick up an overthrow in return.
Fred Klaassen (4-1-20-1) comes back to bowl.
Flatter ball, darted on the pads. Hashmatullah Shahidi nudges it behind square on the leg side towards the short fine leg fielder. A dot to end the over.
Fuller in length, outside off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz eases it down to long off for a single.
Flatter ball, around middle. Rahmanullah Gurbaz keeps it out.
On a length, outside off. Hashmatullah Shahidi drives it towards deep cover and takes a single.
Tossed up, around off. Hashmatullah Shahidi blocks it out.
SIX! BOOM! This is tossed up, around middle. Hashmatullah Shahidi gets down on his knee and smacks it way over the long on fence for a maximum!
Another short ball, angling in from off. Hashmatullah Shahidi pulls it along the ground towards deep square leg for a run.
Banged into the deck, around middle. Hashmatullah Shahidi ducks underneath watchfully.
A yorker-length ball, around off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz squeezes it out towards cover and manages only a run on the Free Hit delivery.
No ball! A slower loopy ball, fuller in length, around off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz digs it out to the off side. Kingma oversteps and the umpire signals a no ball. Free Hit to follow.
Full ball, outside off. Hashmatullah Shahidi prods and carves it through the cover-point region. The fiedler there half-stops it and the batters cross for a run.
Length ball, around middle and leg. Rahmanullah Gurbaz clips it off his pads through the mid-wicket region for a single.
Good-length ball, angling in from middle. Rahmanullah Gurbaz prods and defends it towards mid on.
Floated, on a length, around off. Hashmatullah Shahidi lunges forward to block this one.
Flatter and quicker, around middle. Hashmatullah Shahidi stays back and tucks it towards mid-wicket.
Nicely tossed up, around middle. Hashmatullah Shahidi keeps it out off the front foot.
Flatter ball, shorter in length, around off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz punches it through the extra cover region for a run.
On a length, just outside off. Hashmatullah Shahidi taps it wide of the backward point fielder and takes off for a quick run.
Flatter ball, around middle. Hashmatullah Shahidi blocks it out.
Colin Ackermann is back on, he replaces Philippe Boissevain.
Back of a length, jagging back in from outside off. Hashmatullah Shahidi stays back, rides the bounce well and pulls it along the ground towards deep square leg for a run.
Wide! Kingma serves a short ball, angling down leg. Hashmatullah Shahidi ducks underneath and the umpire calls it a wide.
Back of a length, around middle. Hashmatullah Shahidi punches it past the mid off fielder for a couple of runs.
Good-length ball, around middle. Rahmanullah Gurbaz clips it towards deep mid-wicket. Two was the call from Gurbaz but they settle for a single.
Back of a length, around off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz hangs back and taps it towards cover. Gurbaz wanted a single but it sent back by his skipper.
A short ball, around off. Hashmatullah Shahidi stays back and pulls it along the ground towards deep square leg for a single.
Kingma starts with a length ball, around middle. Rahmanullah Gurbaz tucks it to the leg side for a run.
Vivian Kingma (5-0-13-0) is back into the attack. He replaces Colin Ackermann.
Flatter and quicker, outside off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz stays back and punches it through the extra cover region for a single. A good over for Afghanistan as 9 runs came off it.
Another brilliant effort in the field! Tossed up, down leg. Hashmatullah Shahidi sweeps it behind square on the leg side. The fielder at short fine leg dives and keeps it to just one.
Tossed up, on a length, around middle. Hashmatullah Shahidi blocks it out.
Flatter ball, just outside off. Hashmatullah Shahidi taps it to the fielder at backward point.
A short ball, around off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz rocks back and pulls it wide of the long on fielder. The fielder there dives in front of the ropes and saves a run for his side. Top effort!
FOUR! Top shot! Flatter ball, on a length, around off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz rocks back and lofts it over the cover fielder to fetch himself a boundary.
Tossed up ball, outside off. Hashmatullah Shahidi lunges and defends it out watchfully.
Fuller in length, darting it on the pads. Rahmanullah Gurbaz clips it towards mid-wicket. A single taken.
Outside off, touch fuller. Rahmanullah Gurbaz shuffles across and blocks it out.
Much quicker, turning it in on middle. Rahmanullah Gurbaz stays back and defends this one.
FOUR! SWEPT AWAY! A loopy ball, very full, around middle. Rahmanullah Gurbaz gets down and sweeps it towards deep square leg for a boundary.
Fuller in length, tosses it up on middle. Rahmanullah Gurbaz presses forward and taps it towards square leg. No run taken there.
Loopy ball, around off. Hashmatullah Shahidi leans and defends this one.
Much quicker this time, around the off pole. Hashmatullah Shahidi stays back and blocks it out.
Floated delivery, around off. Hashmatullah Shahidi presses forward and defends it out.
Very full, loopy ball. Rahmanullah Gurbaz pushes it towards long off. A single taken.
Touch fuller, around middle. Hashmatullah Shahidi drives it to long on for a single.
Touch quicker, around middle. Hashmatullah Shahidi blocks it out off the back foot.
Tosses it up, outside off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz leans and blocks it out.
SIX! High and Handsome! Another full ball, around middle. Rahmanullah Gurbaz advances down the pitch and tonks it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
A fuller ball, around off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz blocks it out.
Fuller, around middle and off. Hashmatullah Shahidi drives it to long off for a single.

Well bowled! An appeal for stumping, but the umpire says no. A loopy ball, spinning away from the batter, and forcing Hashmatullah Shahidi to drive this. Hashmatullah Shahidi leans to drive this but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Colin Ackermann begins with a loopy ball, around middle. Rahmanullah Gurbaz pushes it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Outside off, flatter, and quicker. Hashmatullah Shahidi defends it out.
Shorter ball, around middle and leg. Hashmatullah Shahidi pulls it to the fielder at mid-wicket. Dot ball.
Quicker, spinning it in on middle. Hashmatullah Shahidi, on back foot, blocks it out.
Fuller this time, around off. Hashmatullah Shahidi pushes it towards sweeper cover for a brace.

SIX! BOOM! Hashmatullah Shahidi decides to take the spinner on! Philippe Boissevain drops it short, around middle. Hashmatullah Shahidi stays back and pulls it towards the cow corner region for a six.
Tosses it up, a full ball, outside off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz leans and drives it towards deep cover for a single. FIFTY UP FOR Rahmanullah Gurbaz! This has been a top innings so far!
Touch quicker, outside off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz cuts it towards point for a single. He retains the strike.
Fuller ball, around off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz leans and defends it out.

Slower through the air, outside off. Hashmatullah Shahidi covers his stumps and tries to block it, but the ball goes off the outside edge towards third man. Sloppy work in the deep there, allows the batters to take three runs.
Another loopy ball, around middle and leg. Hashmatullah Shahidi leans and blocks it towards the leg side.
Tosses it up, full and around off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz drives it with soft hands towards mid off. A single taken.
A full toss, around off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz pushes it towards the fielder at extra cover.
Hashmatullah Shahidi, the skipper of Afghanistan, comes out to bat.

OUT! STUMPED! A timely breakthrough for Netherlands and the dropped catch hasn't cost them much! This is lovely bowling from Philippe Boissevain! Tossed up nicely, outside off and inviting the batter to drive. Rahmat Shah prods and looks to drive but the ball spins past his outside edge. Scott Edwards behind the sticks collects the ball cleanly and whips the bails off in a flash. Rahmat Shah is short of his crease and he walks back to the hut.
Commentary.Howout: st Scott Edwards b Philippe Boissevain

Commentary.Commentary: Tossed up, around leg. Rahmanullah Gurbaz drills it down to long on for a run.
Fuller in length, around middle. Rahmanullah Gurbaz gets down on his knee and sweeps it behind square on the leg side for a couple of runs.
Flatter ball, on a length, outside off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz taps it to the off side.
Tossed up, outside off. Rahmat Shah skips down the track and pushes it towards long off for a run.
Flatter ball, around off. Rahmat Shah keeps it out.

DROPPED! Oh, dear! The fielder at deep square leg has put down a sitter! Tossed up, around middle. Rahmat Shah gets down on his knee to sweep. The ball goes off the top edge, in the air towards deep square leg. The fielder there settles under it but makes a mess of it in the end. The batters cross for a single. This could prove to be a costly miss for Netherlands.
Tossed up, on a length, around middle. Rahmat Shah blocks it out to the off side.
Chopped on, nearly! Flatter ball, shorter in length, outside off. Shah looks to cut it away from his body. The ball goes off the thick inside edge towards the short fine leg fielder.
Flatter and quicker, outside off. Rahmat Shah cuts it towards cover-point.
Flatter ball, on a length, around off. Rahmat Shah blocks it towards cover.
Tossed up, outside off. Rahmat Shah drives it to the fielder at cover.
Fuller in length, down leg. Rahmat Shah sweeps but the fielder at short fine leg dives to his left and keeps it to just one.
A half-tracker, outside off but Philippe Boissevain gets away with it! Gurbaz mistimes his pull towards long on. A single taken.
Floated, on a length, around off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz blocks it out.
Slightly shorter in length, around off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz waits for the ball to turn and taps it towards backward point.
Tossed up, around off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz keeps it out.
Flatter ball, around middle. Rahmanullah Gurbaz tucks it towards mid-wicket.

DRINKS! Netherlands got to a perfect start! They got an early breakthrough, but since then it's been only Afghanistan! Rahmanullah Gurbaz and Rahmat Shah have looked solid in the middle and have put together 76 runs. Netherlands need to break this partnership to take things under control. Also, Philippe Boissevain comes into the attack.
A bit quicker this time, fuller in length, around middle. Rahmat Shah pushes it towards mid on. Another tidy over from Pieter Seelaar.
Fuller in length, outside off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz drives it towards long off and gives the strike back to Rahmat Shah.
A loopy full toss, around off. Rahmat Shah skips down the track and pushes it towards long off for a run.
Slower through the air, around off. Rahmat Shah stays back and taps it towards backward point.
Tossed up, outside off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz prods and eases it down to long off for a run.
Flatter ball, outside off. Rahmat Shah rocks back and punches it past cover for a single.
Back of a length, outside off. Rahmat Shah stays back and steers it towards third man for a run.
Sloppy from the fielder in the deep and the batters come back for the second run. Fuller in length, around middle. Rahmat Shah nudges it to towards deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Fuller in length, around middle. Rahmanullah Gurbaz drills it down to long on for a run.
Good-length ball, outside off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz pushes it towards cover.
On a length, around off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz defends it out.
SIX! Goes all the way! Stand and deliver stuff from Gurbaz! Length ball, around middle. Rahmanullah Gurbaz frees his arms and goes all the way over the long on fence for a biggie.
Much quicker, flatter, around middle. Rahmat Shah gets an outside edge towards third man. Two runs taken.
Another fuller ball, tosses it up. Rahmanullah Gurbaz chops it away towards cover-point for a quick single.
A loopy ball, full in length, outside off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz leans and drives, but finds the fielder at extra cover.
Pieter Seelaar drops it short this time, around middle and off. Rahmat Shah cuts it towards deep cover for a single.
Flatter ball, around middle and leg. Rahmat Shah stays back and pushes it towards mid-wicket.
A tossed up delivery, around off. Rahmat Shah steps down the pitch and defends it out.
Full-length delivery, outside off. Rahmat Shah drives it towards deep cover. A single to end the over.
Length ball, outside off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz taps it with soft hands towards point and takes a quick single.
Another overpitched delivery, outside off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz pushes it to the fielder at mid off. No run taken.
Ryan Klein serves a fuller length delivery, outside off. Rahmat Shah presses forward and drives it to deep cover for a single.
Back of a length, outside off. Rahmat Shah defends it out off the back foot.
Quick single! A length ball, outside off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz taps it towards mid off and scampers through to the other end. Rahmanullah Gurbaz dives to make his ground.
Flatter ball, around the pads. Rahmanullah Gurbaz tucks it towards square leg. A single taken.
Around middle, flatter delivery. Rahmanullah Gurbaz defends it out off the back foot.
Well bowled! Some turn for Pieter Seelaar! A loopy ball, turning it away from outside off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz stays back and looks to cut it away but gets beaten.
Another shorter ball, around off. Rahmat Shah hangs back and pushes it towards long off for a single.
Tad quicker, around middle and leg. Rahmat Shah, on the back foot, defends it out.
Touch shorter, around middle. Rahmanullah Gurbaz tucks it towards mid-wicket and scampers through to the other end.
Short ball, outside off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz gets an outside edge past the keeper. A single to end the over.
Fuller ball, on middle. Rahmanullah Gurbaz taps it towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
SIX! Oh, shot! A fuller ball, around middle. Rahmanullah Gurbaz shimmies down the pitch and tonks it over long on for a biggie. First six of the innings. That brings up the 50 for Afghanistan!
Another length ball, around off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz taps it towards point. Dot ball.
On a length, outside off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz stays back and defends it out.
Fuller ball, around middle. Rahmanullah Gurbaz presents the full face of his bat and blocks it out.
Shorter, around off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz hangs back and cuts it towards deep cover for a single. Good start by Pieter Seelaar.
Another full ball, on middle. Rahmanullah Gurbaz sweeps it to the fielder at short fine leg.
Nicely tossed up, outside off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz lunges and pushes it to the fielder at point. No run there.
Shorter, quicker, around middle. Rahmanullah Gurbaz stays in his crease and defends it out.
Flatter, around off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz pushes it towards mid off.
Pieter Seelaar begins with a loopy ball, outside off, full in length. Rahmat Shah leans and taps it towards cover. A single taken.
Time for Powerplay 2! Netherlands can now have a maximum of 4 fielders outside the ring till the 40th over. Also, time for some spin as Pieter Seelaar brings himself into the attack.
Good-length ball, around off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz taps it towards point. A dot to end the over. Afghanistan are 43/1 at the end of the Powerplay 1!
Edged but safe! Good-length ball, outside off. Rahmat Shah looks for a booming drive. It goes off the outside edge towards third man for a single.
Drilled but for no run! Fuller in length, outside off. Rahmat Shah drives but finds the extra cover fielder.
FOUR! PUNCHED! Back of a length, just outside off. Rahmat Shah stands tall and caresses it through the cover region for another boundary.
Length ball, around off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz looks to defend but it goes off the outside edge towards third man for a run.
FOUR! Gurbaz greets Klein with a cracking shot! Good-length delivery, outside off. Gurbaz lunges forward and carves it through the cover region for a boundary.
Ryan Klein comes into the attack.
Fuller in length, around middle. Shah stays back and pushes it towards mid on.
Finds the gap this time! Length ball, nipping back in a bit from middle. Rahmanullah Gurbaz nudges it towards deep square leg for a single.
Back of a length, angling in late from middle. Rahmanullah Gurbaz tucks it towards short fine leg and looks for a run but is sent back by his partner at the other end.
Good-length ball, around middle. Rahmanullah Gurbaz keeps it out.
FOUR! CRUNCHED! A bit fuller this time, around middle. Rahmanullah Gurbaz skips down the track and drills it past the diving mid on fielder. The ball races away to the fence.
On a length, around middle. Rahmanullah Gurbaz looks to flick but he misses and gets hit on his pad.
FOUR! Short and wide, and Rahmat Shah pounces on it in a flash! Back of a length, outside off. Rahmat Shah stays back and cuts it through the cover-point region for a boundary.
On a length, just outside off. Rahmat Shah pushes it to the fielder at cover.
Back of a length, around off. Rahmat Shah prods and defends it watchfully.
Good-length ball, around middle. Rahmanullah Gurbaz hops in his crease and tucks it to the leg side for a run.
A slower ball, on a length, around off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz keeps it out.
FOUR! UP AND OVER! Gurbaz breaks the shackles! Fuller in length, outside off. Gurbaz sees the width and frees his arms. He goes over mid off and collects a boundary.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Rahmat Shah pushes it towards mid off. Dot to end the over.
Another full-length delivery, around middle. Rahmat Shah defends it back to the bowler.
Much fuller, around middle. Rahmat Shah pushes it to the fielder at mid on.
Vivian Kingma serves a shorter ball, around off. Rahmat Shah pulls this one but does not quite middle it. The ball will not go all the way, but the batters take two runs.
On a length, angling it in on middle. Rahmat Shah flicks it to mid-wicket once again.
Fuller ball, on middle. Rahmat Shah clips it to mid-wicket.
A slower ball, on a length, around off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz blocks it towards cover. A maiden over from Klaassen and he has been sensational so far with his line and lengths!
This is on a length, jagging back a bit from middle. Rahmanullah Gurbaz tucks it towards mid-wicket.
Good-length ball, around middle. Rahmanullah Gurbaz defends it back to the bowler.
On a length, outside off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz blocks it to the off side.
Top delivery! Short of a length, angling in late from outside off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz looks to block but it goes off the outside edge, on the bounce towards the slip fielder.
Length ball, around off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz blocks it out.
Good end to the over! A fuller ball, around middle. Rahmat Shah pushes it to the fielder at mid-wicket. Just 1 run off that over.
On a length, around middle and leg. Rahmat Shah stays back and blocks it out.
Another short ball, on the body. Rahmanullah Gurbaz pulls it towards deep square leg. That won't go all the way and the batters will take only a single.
Back of a length, outside off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz, on his toes, defends it out.
Another length ball, outside off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz taps it towards backward point. Rahmanullah Gurbaz wants a single here, but he is sent back by his partner.
Good-length delivery, outside the off pole. Rahmanullah Gurbaz stays back and cuts it towards the fielder at cover-point.
Short ball, around middle. Rahmat Shah pulls it towards deep square leg for a brace.
Back of a length, shaping away from outside off. Rahmat Shah leaves it alone.
Fullish ball, around middle. Rahmat Shah blocks it towards point.
A length ball, on the pads. Rahmanullah Gurbaz taps it to square leg. The fielder there runs and throws it to the keeper. The keeper fails to grab it and the batters steal an overthrow.
Another fuller ball, outside off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz blocks this one out solidly.
FOUR! Rahmanullah Gurbaz gets off the mark with a classy cover drive! A fuller ball, outside off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz lunges and drives it past the diving fielder at cover for a boundary.
Vivian Kingma serves a fuller delivery this time, outside off. Rahmat Shah defends it out towards mid off.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Rahmat Shah, on the back foot, pushes it to cover. Dot ball.
Back of a length, outside off. Rahmat Shah blocks it towards point.
Bouncer! Lovely delivery! Short ball, around middle. Rahmat Shah looks to tuck it away on the leg side, but he only manages to get a slight outside edge on the off side.
Slight halt in play. The batter seems to have some issue with the sight screen. The issue is now resolved and we are good to resume play.
Beaten! Good-length delivery, drifting away from outside off. Rahmat Shah goes for the drive but misses.

FOUR! Edgy boundary! Welcome runs for Rahmat Shah. A fuller ball, outside off. Rahmat Shah leans and looks to drive but manages to get an outside edge past the slip fielder. The ball races away towards the third man fence for a boundary. First boundary of the innings!
On a length, wide of off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz will watch it sail through to the keeper. End of a successful over from Fred Klaassen. A wicket and 4 runs off it.
Good-length delivery, on middle. Rahmat Shah looks to block this but gets an outside edge towards third man. A single taken.
Another outswinger, on a length, outside off. Rahmat Shah offers no shot.
WIDE! Length ball, shaping away, wide of off. Rahmat Shah leaves it alone. A wide called.
Touch shorter, outside off. Rahmat Shah leans back and lets that go through to the keeper.
Fuller, outside off. Rahmat Shah pushes it past cover for a brace. He gets off the mark with that.
Rahmat Shah walks in at number 3.

OUT! TIMBER! What a start here for Fred Klaassen! A peach of a delivery by Fred to dismiss Usman Ghani. An inswinging yorker, around the leg pole. Usman Ghani stays in his crease and looks to jam it out, but misses. The ball knocks the leg stump over and sends back Usman Ghani. Classy by Klaassen! Early breakthrough for Netherlands!
Who will bowl from the other end? Fred Klaassen it is.
Much quicker, on the stump, on a length. Rahmanullah Gurbaz defends it out towards mid on. Good start here for Netherlands.
Touch fuller, around middle and leg. Rahmanullah Gurbaz taps it towards mid-wicket. No run there.
A low full toss, darting it on the pads. Rahmanullah Gurbaz looks to heave this but misses. Vivian Kingma is lucky to get away with that.
NO BALL! Good-length delivery, outside off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz stays in his crease and blocks it out. Vivian Kingma has overstepped here and a no ball is called. Free hit to follow...
Wide of off, touch shorter. Rahmanullah Gurbaz looks to slash this one, but misses.
Another length ball, outside off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz leaves it alone.
BEATEN STRAIGHTAWAY! Vivian Kingma begins with a length ball, outside off, hint of away movement. Rahmanullah Gurbaz looks to have a poke at it but gets beaten on the outside edge.

We are set for the game to begin! The players of Netherlands have made their way out in the middle. Rahmanullah Gurbaz and Usman Ghani will open the batting for Afghanistan. Vivian Kingma will start the proceedings with the ball.

Pieter Seelaar, the skipper of Netherlands, says that they would have batted first as well, but he is happy to bowl first. Mentions that they bowled well in the first 10 overs in the last game, but the last 10 overs were a little tough. Says that the wicket looks sticky as compared to the pitch of the first ODI. Informs that they have one change to their side.

Hashmatullah Shahidi, the skipper of Afghanistan, says they will bat first. Adds that the wicket looks good to bat on and they will look to put up a good score on the board. Mentions that in the previous game, the ball wasn't quite coming onto the bat but they are hoping that this wicket will help their batters.

Netherlands (Playing XI) - Musa Ahmed, Scott Edwards (WK), Fred Klaassen, Colin Ackermann, Pieter Seelaar (C), Boris Gorlee, Saqib Zulfiqar, Vivian Kingma, Ryan Klein (In for Brandon Glover), Philippe Boissevain, Bas de Leede.

Afghanistan (Playing XI) - Rahmanullah Gurbaz (WK), Usman Ghani, Rahmat Shah, Hashmatullah Shahidi (C), Najibullah Zadran, Gulbadin Naib, Sharafuddin Ashraf, Rashid Khan, Mujeeb Ur Rahman, Fareed Ahmad (In for Shahidullah Kamal), Yamin Ahmadzai.
TOSS - Afghanistan have won the toss and they have elected to BAT first.

Netherlands did a good job with the ball in the first ODI but it was their batters who weren't at their best and in the end they had to face a defeat. Coming into this clash, their batting unit must ensure that they put their best foot forward and bat well against a quality bowling attack of Afghanistan. Will the Dutch stage a comeback and level the series? We'll find that soon. Stay tuned for toss and team news.

Afghanistan did manage to come out on top in the first ODI and they will be high on confidence coming into this clash. Their skipper, Hashmatullah Shahidi led from the front with the bat and then it was their bowlers who put on a show in the second innings. They will now be looking to wrap the series up in the second ODI and grab those 10 crucial WC Super League points.

Hello and a very warm welcome to the coverage of the 2nd ODI between Afghanistan and Netherlands. This promises to be an exciting contest as the series is on the line and World Cup Super League points are up for grab.
